question.problem:
Find the average rate of change of the function $y=-2x$ over the interval $x\in [4,4+h]$, where $h>0$ is a parameter.

The average rate of change is
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Let $f(x)=-2x.$ Notice that we are given the length $h$ of the interval, so we use

$$
\frac{Δy}{Δx}=\frac{f(a+h)-f(a)}{h},
$$

with $a=4.$ Substituting into the formula gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{Δy}{Δx} & =\frac{f(4+h)-f(4)}{h} \\  & =\frac{-2(4+h)-(-2)(4)}{h} \\  & =\frac{-8-2h+8}{h} \\  & =\frac{-2\cancel{h}}{\cancel{h}} \\  & =-2.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the average rate of change is $-2.$
